subject: Simple class condition
notes: kb/Work PB590. The rule had no site at all before the BOOLEAN alternative existed. It is one category short of SR4's list on purpose - a BOOLEAN class test over a category-boolean item is the ordinary case, and the 2002 golden's A line pins it - so the two rules are separate table entries with separate codes (COBOL2201 here, COBOL0844 for SR4). Editions are 2002+ because BOOLEAN is not a reserved word at COBOL-85, where the same spelling is governed by the user-defined-word alternative (conformance:cases/_unassigned/pb590-boolean-class-condition-below-2002).
